flows.title: Create an event type
steps: Go to the event types page and click the New event type button in the top right.
Fill in the Title, the URL (for example cal.com/bailey/example-event), a Description and the Length.

flows.title: Create an availability schedule
steps: Click New in the top-right corner.
Enter a name for the schedule, then click Continue to create it.

flows.title: Share a private link to an event type
steps: Go to Event Types and select the event type.
Toggle Private Link on. Click Add Private Link for more links, then save the private link configuration and the event type settings.
Copy the generated link and share it only with the intended invitees.
